properties.site-address: Listed Buildings at Police HQ, Ponteland
properties.notes: Redevelopment of the listed former office buildings at the former police HQ site through conversion and change of use. This will provide 22 units as part of the wider redevelopment site (17/03697/FUL). Completion of this discreet element is expected by 2021/22.
